title: D&D Simulator Pack v1.0.0
description: JSON Schema for content packs consumed by a conformant engine. Mirrors the prose in specs/04-content-packs-and-sfs.md (Section 2 for the top-level shape; Section 6 for the *Def shapes referenced below). Unknown top-level keys MUST be rejected at load time; this is enforced here via `additionalProperties: false`. Shared primitive types (ids, RollSpec, RollResult, Modifier, DamageInstance, PersistentEffectInstance, JsonFilter, etc.) live in specs/sfs/v1/_common.json and are referenced via relative $ref.

pack_schema_version.description: Must match engine.supported_schema_range. 1.0.0 for this spec.

sfs_version.description: SFS registry version the pack targets. Minor-version backcompat allowed.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of canonical body sans manifest.checksum; verified at load.

extends.description: Dependency PackIds; cycles are rejected at load.

AbilityScoreDef.description: Proficiency bonus and score tables. The pack names what ability scores exist and how proficiency bonus scales with level.

modifier_formula.description: How to derive the score's modifier. 'div2_floor_minus_5' is the canonical 5e-shaped form (floor(score/2) - 5). Packs may pick others from the closed set.

ResourceDef.description: Shape of a ResourcePool template. Runtime pools are ResourcePool in 02-domain-model.md, and are instantiated from these definitions with per-entity max/current values.

ClockDef.description: Named time scale. Durations and recoveries reference these tags so content packs can redefine time.

unit.description: Conceptual unit for display. Not used by the engine for arithmetic - clocks are opaque u64 counters.

ticks_per.description: Optional conversion hint: how many ticks of a smaller clock equal one tick of this clock. Engine does not auto-convert.

DamageTypeDef.description: A pack-defined damage type. Packs enumerate the damage types they use; effect bodies reference them by id.

ConditionDef.description: A named condition (Poisoned, Stunned, ...). Applied via sfs.condition.apply; encoded at runtime as a PersistentEffectInstance referencing the condition's template.

stackable.description: If false, reapplication refreshes duration; if true, instances accumulate.

exclusive_group.description: Applying a condition with the same exclusive_group removes the existing one.

ItemTemplate.description: Template for items. Item instances in an entity's Inventory reference a template by id.

armor_class_formula.description: For armor/shield. Expression string interpreted by pack-defined SFS, not the engine.

L10n.description: Optional locale map. Outer key is a BCP-47-ish locale, inner key is a translation key (typically the id of a def), value is the translated string. Engines not implementing localization ignore this entirely.

LevelUpStepConfig.description: One step in the level-up flow for a class. The engine walks these in order, calling legal_choices_fn to build the PromptDecision and apply_fn to apply the result. See specs/08 Section 2.

at_levels.description: If present, this step only applies at specific levels. If absent, applies at every level-up.

Prerequisite.description: Closed enumeration of prerequisite kinds. Used by ActionDef and FeatDef. See specs/05 Section 7.2.

ScalingSpec.description: Describes how an effect scales (e.g. per spell slot above base, per caster level, etc.).

ActionDef.description: A declared action a character or monster may take. See specs/04 Section 6.1 and specs/05 Section 7.

TriggerCondition.description: Closed union of trigger condition kinds. See specs/03 Section 4.

TriggerDef.description: See specs/03 Section 4 and specs/04 Section 6.3.

TransformSpec.description: Closed union of transform operations. See specs/03 Section 6.

EffectBody.description: Declarative effect body. See specs/03 Section 2.

EffectTemplateDef.description: Template for an effect node. See specs/04 Section 6.2.

FormulaNode.description: Tiny arithmetic tree for derived stat computation. Max depth 8, enforced at load. No loops, no variables, no functions. See specs/05 Section 8.

SceneTemplate.description: Pack-provided starter scene. See specs/06 Section 7.
